main.description: Governance proposal payload emitted by TreasuryRebalanceCell when observed-vs-target tier drift exceeds drift_threshold_bps. Per ADR-2605172300 §3.3 + §4. Records the proposalId on geth-private Governance, the observed/target/drift basis points per tier (流動/準備/本財), and the IPFS CID of the rebalance rationale doc. The proposal itself is gated by Constitution.getMutable('timelock_secs') (default 72h); execution emits separate payment.sent + payment.split records.

proposalId.description: Governance.sol proposalCount value returned from propose().

txHash.description: geth-private tx hash of the Governance.propose() call.

descCid.description: IPFS CID of the rebalance rationale doc (Markdown), pinned by ipfs-pinner.

navLiquidUsdcMicros.description: TreasuryMirror.tierLatest(TIER_LIQUID) at proposal time, USDC base units (6 decimals).

navReserveUsdcMicros.description: TreasuryMirror.tierLatest(TIER_RESERVE) at proposal time, USDC base units.

navCorpusUsdcMicros.description: TreasuryMirror.tierLatest(TIER_CORPUS) at proposal time, USDC base units.

observedLiquidBps.description: Observed 流動 share at proposal time (= navLiquid * 10_000 / navTotal).

observedReserveBps.description: Observed 準備 share at proposal time.

observedCorpusBps.description: Observed 本財 share at proposal time.

driftThresholdBps.description: Absolute drift threshold per tier that triggered this proposal. Default 500 (5%).

kappaBps.description: Constitution.getMutable('kappa_bps') at proposal time, clamped to kappa_floor_bps / kappa_ceiling_bps band.

epochSeconds.description: Unix seconds of the monthly cron tick that produced this proposal.
